# Localization Teams Notification Template

Use this template to inform localization teams about the repo freeze and release timeline.

**When to use:** Release Week (Week 12) - before the release

**Where to post:** GitHub discussion created in Phase 1 ([Introduce Yourself to Localization Teams](#13-introduce-yourself-to-localization-teams))

---

## Message Template

```markdown
Hello localization team leads! 👋

Quick update: We are on track for the v[future release] release on [Release Date]. All Kubernetes website branches are up to date (main, dev-[future-release]). 

No action required from your side at this time. Let me know if I can help with anything!

Thanks!
```

---

## Example

```markdown
Hello localization team leads! 👋

Quick update: We are on track for the v1.35 release on December 17, 2024. All Kubernetes website branches are up to date (main, dev-1.35). 

No action required from your side at this time. Let me know if I can help with anything!

Thanks!
